scope: Controller tests using minimal fake DOM/media; not rendered-video, audio synchronization, listening or browser QA
mode: actual timing metadata; mocked media events, no decoded-video or browser QA

tests.name: Builder rejects old forty-slide media, wrong anchors, missing pauses and double-counted opening work
Default playback starts with Opening 01 and no repeated reading assignment
All forty historical core anchors retain their original semantic target
Every opening anchor selects its own chapter without colliding with core slide numbers
Hash changes and the opening/core start links select explicitly without autoplay
The R1–R3 pause stops before answers and Continue advances to Opening 14
A delayed update cannot expose opening answers before the R1–R3 pause
Opening 14 transitions continuously to the original core slide 1
All nine required core work stops remain intact
Study labels distinguish opening and core introduction and preserve explicit ranges
Delayed core task updates rewind without revealing checks
Required investigation Continue resumes at the correct core check
Intentional chapter and native seeks do not trigger earlier opening or core tasks
Both Lab demo links resolve after the opening offset and retain prediction instructions
Both prediction stops precede Lab demos and resume into them
Replay reinstates opening and core pauses
Turning pauses off permits manual playback and clears the current task
Timer and frame guards handle opening attempts and optional choices without timeupdate
Optional H choice skips to the correctly offset form chapter and stays paused
Optional H Continue resumes the optional check only after an explicit choice
Optional H navigation appears only on core slides 35–38
Ten-minute break resumes core slide 21 after the opening offset
Final form pause leads once to receipt check without another submission stop
Delayed natural ended event catches unfinished form but intentional final jump does not
Transcript counts integrated narration once and labels opening versus historical core slides
Wide captions remain native; narrow captions use active timed cues below the image
Caption toggle disables both presentations and restores the appropriate narrow mode
Native full screen uses native captions; narrow wrapper full screen retains separate captions
Late caption loading attaches cue updates and desktop native CC changes update the toggle
Production media requires an encoded hash and versions every media URL consistently
